title: On Adding a line to the letter
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：add　|　正文 364 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 add 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the headmaster ① added a line to the letter for the whole place, and every student in the school said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the headmaster ② adds a line to the letter without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ add a line to the letter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ added a line to the letter before — a line in the record for October 1943 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Adding a line to the letter for the whole place, the headmaster said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ add a word of warning before we left without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Add a word of warning before we left at once and never mention it again.

By 1956 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new student from the next school ⑧ adds a word of warning before we left for the whole place every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ added a line to the letter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To add a line to the letter, my mother said in 1961, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the school remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the school forgets, somebody adds a line to the letter without a word of thanks again and somebody must add a line to the letter for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 添加（一般过去式 added a line to the letter：1949 年校长头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 添加（一般现在 adds a line to the letter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 添加（不定式 to add a line to the letter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 添加（过去完成时 had added a line to the letter：1943 年十月的学籍册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 添加（动名词 adding a line to the letter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 补充说（add a word of warning before we left：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去补充说临走前补的一句提醒）
G. v. 补充说（add a word of warning before we left：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 添加（后段两处：新来的学生照例 adds a word of warning before we left，而母亲又一次 added a line to the letter）

items.q: added a line to the letter
adds a line to the letter

adding a line to the letter

answers.why: add 意为“添加”，1949 年校长替所有人添加信上添了一行，那是学堂里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 added。
add 意为“添加”，自那以后校长不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 adds。
add 意为“添加”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯添加信上添了一行”，此处为不定式 to add a line to the letter。
add 意为“添加”，学籍册里 十月 那行字说明早在 1956 年之前就有人添加过，故用过去完成时 had added。
add 意为“添加”，校长说“添加信上添了一行这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 adding a line to the letter 作主语。
add 意为“补充说”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去补充说临走前补的一句提醒”，should ever 之后用原形 add a word of warning before we left。
add 意为“补充说”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻补充说临走前补的一句提醒（add a word of warning before we left at once），以后再也不要提起。
add 意为“添加”，新来的学生每个学年都照例补充说临走前补的一句提醒，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 adds。
add 意为“添加”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人添加信上添了一行，用一般过去式 added 叙述。
add 意为“添加”，结尾那句是母亲 1961 年的话：要添加信上添了一行，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和学堂记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年，校长替所有人添加信上添了一行；学堂里每一个学生都说这是头一回。（added a line to the letter）
多年以后，校长仍不图一句谢做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（adds a line to the letter）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯添加信上添了一行这件事本身。（to add a line to the letter）
早在 1943 年就有人添加信上添了一行，十月那天学籍册上的一行字就是证据。（had added a line to the letter）
校长说过，替所有人添加信上添了一行这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（adding a line to the letter 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻补充说临走前补的一句提醒，以后再也不要提起。（add a word of warning before we left，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 add 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the headmaster added a line to the letter for the whole place, and nobody in the school forgot it.
Even now the headmaster adds a line to the letter without a word of thanks whenever the school asks.
Adding a line to the letter for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever add a word of warning before we left without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next school adds a word of warning before we left for the whole place every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother added a line to the letter again, and the school remembered that half.
